A-RMOM1.family: Momentum risk management (Agent A web scout)
A-RMOM1.name: Risk-managed momentum (Barroso & Santa-Clara 2015): the SQ6-MTUM book sized to a 12% volatility target
A-RMOM1.explain: RULE (written 25 Oct 2026 before any test): hold the SQ6-MTUM book as now, but at each formation put min(1, 0.12 / sigma) of the money in it, sigma = the annualised standard deviation of the book's own daily returns over the previous 126 sessions (the previous formation's picks held equally; under 126 sessions of history: 1); the rest in cash at 0%. Yardsticks: the unscaled SQ6-MTUM book, SPY, the average stock; both halves; the worst month and the worst drawdown reported next to the return per year. Long-only version (the paper scales a long-short book).
A-RMOM1.data: has it: the 5-year daily price cache and the SQ6-MTUM rebuild (squad20-lab.mjs / agent-a-tgt-lab.mjs).
A-RMOM1.note: Web scout 25 Oct 2026. Queue position: Agent A item after A-TGT1.

C-SPEC1.name: Special situations: cash tender offers and index additions
C-SPEC1.explain: (1) Announced all-cash tender offers / mergers for halal targets: buy at the next open after the 8-K/SC TO-T when the spread to the offer price is 3-15%, hold to close of the deal or 120 sessions, exit on deal break; report deal-break losses separately. (2) Additions to the S&P 500/400/600 announced by S&P (official press releases): buy at the next open after the announcement, sell at the close before the effective date. Halal of the target decided by ZAD.

SQ6-MTUM.name: MSCI USA Momentum index method (iShares MTUM): risk-adjusted 6 and 12-month momentum, semi-annual
SQ6-MTUM.explain: RULE: At the close of the last session of May and of November. Universe: the 600 most traded liquid stocks with 252+ sessions of history (MSCI USA proxy). 12-month momentum = close 21 sessions ago / close 252 sessions ago - 1; 6-month = close 21 ago / close 126 ago - 1; each divided by the annualised standard deviation of weekly returns over up to 3 years (156 weeks, 52 at least); each turned into a z-score across the universe, averaged 50/50, standardised again and winsorised at +-3. BUY the next open the 120 stocks (20% of the universe) with the highest positive combined z-score. SELL at the close of session 126 (the next review). DEVIATIONS from the published method: Market-cap x score weighting, the 50% buffer and the ad-hoc rebalance are not modelled; equal weight per trade; no risk-free rate (it is common to every stock); the first reviews have under 3 years of weekly returns; the universe is a traded-value proxy. Common (squad6-core.mjs header): liquid = close 5 USD+ and 20-session average traded value 5M USD+; whole market with dead stocks (5-year cache); large-cap universes = the most traded liquid stocks by 63-session traded value (survivor-free proxy for market-cap rank). Entries never before the next session (next open, or a resting limit / buy-stop filled at the level or the open if through it); close-based exits at the NEXT open; intraday stop and target on the same day = stop; a stock that stops trading = its last close. Cost 0.8% (1.2% stress). Judged once (first complete run frozen, data/squad6-lab.json firstRun) at the tier-2 standard on both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01) with the yardstick and the rule both capped at +300% (AUD-1): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock bought and sold at the same moments, better than the same stock on its other days, > 0 without its 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks per half, block t >= 2.5. Win rate, average win / loss and newer-vs-older reported.

B-FCF1.name: Cash-rich, growing, low-debt companies (the measurable filters from the chain screener)
B-FCF1.explain: Monthly basket, point in time from SEC XBRL (10-Q/10-K as filed): free-cash-flow yield > 5% (trailing 4 quarters operating cash flow minus capex, over market cap), revenue growth >= 10% year on year, debt-to-equity < 0.5, and, for companies that hold inventory, days of inventory < 60; stock above its 200-day average. Equal weight, hold 3 months. Compared with the average stock, with V15 (F-score in an uptrend) on the same dates, and with the same stocks in months they did not qualify; both halves, 0.8%/1.2% cost, without the 2 best, t >= 2.5. Supplier diversification and on-time delivery are not public data and are left out.
B-FCF1.note: From the owner's Stock Chain Screener image and prompts of 23 Oct. Pre-registered before any run. Low debt also fits common halal screens, but halal stays ZAD's decision.
B-FCF1.built: Built 23 Oct 2026 before any result (value-lab.mjs + value-core.mjs fcfCheck): formation every 21 sessions (as quality.mjs), liquid stocks (5 USD+, 5M USD+ a day); SEC companyfacts point in time (a filing counts from the day after its filing date); TTM = 10-K year, or YTD + last year - YTD a year earlier; capex = PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment / ProductiveAssets (unknown -> left out); market value = split-adjusted share count known 30 days after its date x close; FCF yield 40%+ treated as a data error (quality.mjs bound); revenue growth = TTM vs TTM a year earlier, same tag; debt = LongTermDebt (incl. current) else the parts reported that date, none if the company never reported debt; filings 200+ days old = stale. Buy next open, sell the close 63 sessions later. Judged at the owner tier-2 standard (block t over 63-session blocks).
